pairs: Addideruntque filii Israël facere malum in conspectu Domini post mortem Aod,
But after the death of Ehud, the sons of Israel resumed doing evil in the sight of the Lord.
et tradidit illos Dominus in manus Jabin regis Chanaan,
And the Lord delivered them into the hands of Jabin, the king of Canaan,
habuitque ducem exercitus sui nomine Sisaram,
And he had a commander of his army named Sisera,
ipse autem habitabat in Haroseth gentium.
but this man lived at Harosheth of the Gentiles.
And the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord.
For he had nine hundred chariots with scythes,
et per viginti annos vehementer oppresserat eos.
and he vehemently oppressed them for twenty years.
Erat autem Debbora prophetis uxor Lapidoth,
Now there was a prophetess, Deborah, the wife of Lappidoth,
quæ judicabat populum in illo tempore.
who judged the people in that time.
And she was sitting under a palm tree,
which was called by her name,
ascendebantque ad eam filii Israël in omne judicium.
And the sons of Israel went up to her for every judgment.
Quæ misit et vocavit Barac filium Abinoëm de Cedes Nephthali:
And she sent and called Barak, the son of Abinoam, from Kedesh of Naphtali.
“The Lord, the God of Israel, instructs you:
Vade, et duc exercitum in montem Thabor,
‘Go and lead an army to Mount Tabor,
tollesque tecum decem millia pugnatorum de filiis Nephthali, et de filiis Zabulon:
and you shall take with you ten thousand fighting men from the sons of Naphtali and from the sons of Zebulun.
ego autem adducam ad te in loco torrentis Cison,
Then I will lead to you, at the place of the torrent Kishon,
Sisera, the leader of the army of Jabin,
et currus ejus, atque omnem multitudinem,
with his chariots and the entire multitude.
et tradam eos in manu tua.
And I will deliver them into your hand.’”
If you are not willing to come with me,
sed in hac vice victoria non reputabitur tibi,
But due to this change, the victory shall not be reputed to you.
quia in manu mulieris tradetur Sisara.
And so Sisera will be delivered into the hand of a woman.”
et perrexit cum Barac in Cedes.
and she traveled with Barak to Kedesh.
ascended with ten thousand fighting men,
Haber autem Cinæus recesserat quondam a ceteris Cinæis fratribus suis,
Now Heber, the Kenite, had previously withdrawn from the rest of the Kenites,
his brothers, the sons of Hobab,
et tetenderat tabernacula usque ad vallem, quæ vocatur Sennim,
the relative of Moses. And he had pitched his tents as far as the valley that is called Zaanannim,
Nuntiatumque est Sisaræ quod ascendisset Barac filius Abinoëm in montem Thabor:
And it was reported to Sisera that Barak, the son of Abinoam, had ascended to Mount Tabor.
And he gathered together the nine hundred chariots with scythes,
et omnem exercitum de Haroseth gentium ad torrentem Cison.
and the entire army, from Harosheth of the Gentiles to the torrent Kishon.
For this is the day on which the Lord delivers Sisera into your hands.
in qua tradidit Dominus Sisaram in manus tuas:
Descendit itaque Barac de monte Thabor,
et decem millia pugnatorum cum eo.
and the ten thousand fighting men with him.
And the Lord struck Sisera with great fear,
and all his chariots and all his multitude with the edge of the sword,
universamque multitudinem in ore gladii ad conspectum Barac:
And Barak pursued the fleeing chariots,
et exercitum usque ad Haroseth gentium,
and the army, as far as Harosheth of the Gentiles.
et omnis hostium multitudo usque ad internecionem caderet.
And the entire multitude of the enemy was cut down, unto utter annihilation.
Sisara autem fugiens pervenit ad tentorium Jahel uxoris Haber Cinæi. Erat enim pax inter Jabin regem Asor, et domum Haber Cinæi.
But Sisera, while fleeing, arrived at the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber, the Kenite. For there was peace between Jabin, the king of Hazor, and the house of Heber, the Kenite.
Egressa igitur Jahel in occursum Sisaræ,
Therefore, Jael went out to meet Sisera,
Qui ingressus tabernaculum ejus, et opertus ab ea pallio,
And he entered her tent, and having been covered by her with a cloak,
And she opened a bottle of milk,
and she gave him to drink.
“Stand before the door of the tent.
et cum venerit aliquis interrogans te,
Tulit itaque Jahel uxor Haber clavum tabernaculi,
And so Jael, the wife of Heber, took a spike from the tent,
et ingressa abscondite et cum silentio,
And entering unseen and with silence,
posuit supra tempus capitis ejus clavum,
she placed the spike over the temple of his head.
percussumque malleo defixit in cerebrum usque ad terram:
And striking it with the mallet, she drove it through his brain,
as far as the ground. And so, joining deep sleep to death,
Et ecce Barac sequens Sisaram veniebat:
And behold, Barak arrived, in pursuit of Sisera.
And Jael, going out to meet him,
et ostendam tibi virum quem quæris.
and I will show you the man whom you are seeking.”
Qui cum intrasset ad eam, vidit Sisaram jacentem mortuum,
And when he had entered her tent, he saw Sisera lying dead,
et clavum infixum in tempore ejus.
with the spike fixed in his temples.
Humiliavit ergo Deus in die illo Jabin regem Chanaan coram filiis Israël:
Thus did God humble Jabin, the king of Canaan, on that day, before the sons of Israel.
et forti manu opprimebant Jabin regem Chanaan,
And with a strong hand they overpowered Jabin, the king of Canaan,
